note: Prediction arrays of the cells that were trained after the ten result families of the first cohort were released. The driver wrote one array beside each result file, as for every other cell. No committed file is computed from these arrays: the figures reported from these cells are in the result files. They are released so that those figures can be recomputed (code/check_arrays.py). They are attached to the tagged release named in release.json, one tarball per result directory, or one per training seed where a single tarball would exceed the size a release asset may have, and are not part of the data record.
